description: Analysis: calibration of 20 E1 predictions vs 20 E3 measurements and probability the measured argmax was missed
observation: n=20 measured: min 2.8, max 5.0, mean 3.61, sd 0.62 (g). OLS measured = -8.100 + 3.489*predicted; residual sd 0.465; Pearson 0.680; Spearman 0.473. The three highest-predicted lines measured 5.0/4.5/4.6, the three highest measured. All 884 unqueried lines have predicted <= 3.171 (fitted mean <= 2.96 g); to beat 5.0 they would need a residual >= ~2.0 g = ~4.4 residual SD. Estimated P(at least one unqueried line > 5.0) is ~0.0000 at the empirical sd 0.465, ~0.003 at sd 0.6, and ~0.06 at an implausibly large sd 0.8. Best estimate of the measured argmax is therefore the directly measured IRIS_313.12254 (5.0 g), with a gap to the runner-up 12349 (4.7 g).
